_comment: When each shipped data file was actually captured from its source. Recorded explicitly because a file's modification time resets whenever it is copied, which made the app report the day it was deployed as the day the slate was pulled. UPDATE THESE WHEN YOU REFRESH A FILE -- the header showed Week 1 dates against a Week 2 slate because this was forgotten once.

slate.source: DraftKings salary export, Week 4 2026 ($400K Spy and $75K Red Zone exports are byte-identical)
slate.note: 587 players, 11 games. Statuses at the pull: 467 active, 69 ir, 27 out, 23 q, 1 d.

contests.source: DraftKings lobby screenshot plus 7 contest-detail captures
contests.note: 24 Classic contests. Payout grids captured for 7; the other 17 are lobby rows only and are unplayable until a grid exists. 17 of 24 are within a $100 week; the four $100 Spy/Hot Route seats, the $88 Octopus and the two $75 contests are not.

variance.note: Each player's own scoring spread. 359 of 670 matched on the Week 2 slate; the rest fall back to a flat positional multiple and are labelled inferred.

prior.note: 578 players. Flat 2025 average, blended against the in-season average at n/(n+3) so a single Week 1 game cannot carry a projection.

kalshi.source: Kalshi public read API, player prop ladders
kalshi.note: 180 of 629 DK players matched exactly. Not used by the projection -- forward validation only. Passing-TD and anytime-TD markets returned nothing at this capture, as in Week 3.

usage.note: 460 players, 401 with touches joined. Snap data now covers weeks 1-4.

gameTotals.note: 16 games. Adjusts the CEILING only, capped at +/-4%. Measured worth: nothing on expected points (+0.33/player, 1.5 sd over 11,401 player-weeks), about 3% on the 85th percentile. Week 4 spread runs 38.5 (PIT@CLE, GB@TB, MIA@MIN) to 51.5 (JAX@CIN, DET@CAR).
